name: Liberty Prime
description: (Tag:mechanical)(Tag:tech)(Tech)"Democracy is non-negotiable." Liberty Prime is a large pre-war American mech with armor immune to anything below a ballistic missile and strength to handle a superhuman behemoth like a toddler. It has laser Gatlings that combine into one death beam and throws mini nukes like footballs, with energy and ammunition refreshed every 24 hours, including 8 Mini Nukes.
